name: tminus
author: seagle
description: The running tminus countdown in the bar, with a popup to control every running timer

barWidget.description: The running tminus countdown: left = pause/resume, middle = next segment, right = all timers with controls, scroll = add/take time

schema.label: tminus command
schema.description: The t- binary, if it is not on the login shell's PATH (e.g. ~/.cargo/bin/t-).

schema.label: Timer name
schema.description: Follow only the timer with this name (t- -n NAME). Empty follows the newest timer.

schema.label: Scroll step
schema.description: Time added or taken per scroll notch, e.g. 1m or 30s.

schema.label: Start arguments
schema.description: With no timer running, show an icon that starts t- with these arguments, e.g. 25m:work 5m:break x4 --notify. It always runs --headless. Empty hides the widget while no timer runs.
